stemMd: Why is using the same inspection procedure important?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It ensures every resident files a complaint.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It makes lighting irrelevant by definition.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It eliminates the need for a sample.

options.label: D
options.textMd: It guarantees no bicycle will ever be damaged.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It reduces the risk that a change in measurement itself creates an apparent change in damage.

explanationMd: Holding observation procedures constant helps compare underlying damage across periods. Otherwise a new inspection method could create the same detection problem the analyst identified in complaint counts.

distractorRationale.c: A fixed sample is explicitly proposed.
distractorRationale.b: Lighting can still affect damage or visibility.
distractorRationale.a: Inspections are distinct from voluntary complaints.
distractorRationale.d: Measurement does not prevent all damage.
